{%- set night = is_state('binary_sensor.lighting_night', 'on') -%}{%- set ns = namespace(r=[]) -%}{%- for s in states.input_boolean | selectattr('object_id', 'match', 'climate_room_') | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') -%}{%- set room = s.object_id[13:] -%}{%- set t = ('input_number.climate_target_night_' if night else 'input_number.climate_target_day_') ~ room -%}{%- if has_value(t) and not is_hidden_entity(t) -%}{%- set ns.r = ns.r + [{'a': area_name(t) or room | replace('_', ' ') | title, 't': t, 'f': 'input_boolean.climate_air_filter_' ~ room}] -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- set ns2 = namespace(t=[], f=[]) -%}{%- for r in ns.r | sort(attribute='a') -%}{%- set ns2.t = ns2.t + [{'type': 'tile', 'entity': r.t, 'name': r.a, 'icon': 'mdi:weather-night' if night else 'mdi:thermometer', 'features': [{'type': 'numeric-input', 'style': 'buttons'}], 'features_position': 'bottom'}] -%}{%- if has_value(r.f) -%}{%- set ns2.f = ns2.f + [{'type': 'tile', 'entity': r.f, 'name': r.a, 'icon': 'mdi:air-filter', 'vertical': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'toggle'}, 'icon_tap_action': {'action': 'toggle'}}] -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ([{'type': 'grid', 'columns': 2, 'square': false, 'cards': ns2.t}] if ns2.t else []) + ([{'type': 'grid', 'columns': 4, 'square': false, 'cards': ns2.f}] if ns2.f else []) }}
